chane-bh-hong-kong.rule: Chane's list from Battle Hardened: Hong Kong (1st). The default 40 leaves the two Pummel, both Right Behind You, the Sift and the Timesnap Potion in the sideboard: generic cards that do nothing for the Runechant, banish and rune gate plan.
